slot_generation_rule: For replicate r in numeric order 1,2,3: traverse that replicate's frozen task_order from first to last; for each task emit its three conditions in that replicate's frozen condition_order. Number emitted measured observations consecutively from slot 1 through slot 108. R/C acquisition occurs inside the corresponding slot after fresh backend/recorder start and immediately before that slot's measured request.
restart_rule: Every emitted B/R/C measured observation starts with its own fresh backend process and fresh recorder/session. B has no acquisition request. R/C have exactly one constituted acquisition request inside that fresh process before the measured request.
outcome_independence: No task or condition may be reordered, skipped, promoted, delayed, or substituted because of latency, output, success, failure, thermal behavior, memory behavior, or any prior observation. Inadmissible/failed slots remain in custody and do not trigger immediate unscheduled replacement.
replacement_rule: No replacement schedule is constituted in v0.1.1. Any need for replacement observations blocks completeness until a separate outcome-blind replacement protocol is prospectively frozen.
